title: A Second Chance on the Workshop Floor

paragraphs.en: A repair workshop offered a young mechanic a second chance after a serious mistake. The response from his colleagues was fierce, and one supervisor remained openly hostile. The mechanic, Daniel, felt guilt whenever he saw the damaged machine. His first instinct was to become passive and say nothing, hoping the incident would disappear. However, the owner insisted that integrity required a straightforward account of what had happened. Saying sorry would matter only if it was followed by responsible action. Daniel needed courage to explain his decisions, especially because the workshop had previously praised him as a brilliant newcomer.
paragraphs.zh: 维修车间让年轻技工丹尼尔在一次严重失误后得到第二次机会。同事反应激烈，一名主管公开敌视他。他每次看见受损设备都感到内疚，本能地想被动沉默，等事情过去。老板却强调，诚实正直要求直接说明经过。道歉必须伴随负责的行动才有意义。解释自己的决定需要勇气，尤其因为大家此前一直称他为出色的新人。

paragraphs.en: At the meeting, Daniel resisted the temptation to present himself as an innocent victim of misfortune. He gave a frank description of the shortcut he had taken and admitted that it was stupid. The owner remained polite but explained why even a mild departure from safety rules could cause distress. There was nothing noble about protecting personal esteem at another person's expense. Daniel felt shame, yet the clear discussion also offered relief: suspicion could finally be replaced by facts. For the first time since the accident, he understood the difference between accepting responsibility and deciding that his whole character was worthless.
paragraphs.zh: 会上，丹尼尔没有把自己说成遭遇不幸的无辜受害者。他坦率描述抄近路的做法，并承认愚蠢。老板保持礼貌，却解释即使轻微偏离安全规定，也可能带来痛苦。牺牲他人利益来维护个人声望毫不高尚。丹尼尔羞愧，但清楚的讨论也让他释然：事实终于取代了怀疑。他开始理解，承担责任不同于认定自己一无是处。

paragraphs.en: The workshop assigned him a tedious inspection task alongside an experienced technician, Rosa. At first he found the work dull and awkward. Rosa could occasionally annoy him with her peculiar habit of asking the same question twice. Yet she refused to call him lazy or ignorant when he struggled. She explained that a vivid memory of failure was useful only if it improved future judgment. Her affection for the craft was evident in the elegant repairs she produced, and Daniel gradually became grateful for her patience. Their relationship remained professional, but the long afternoons allowed an intimate understanding of how each person approached uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 车间安排他与资深技师罗莎做枯燥检查。起初工作乏味，也令他尴尬。罗莎总把同一个问题问两遍，这个特别习惯有时让他烦躁，但他遇到困难时，她从不说他懒惰或无知。她解释，失败的鲜明记忆只有改善以后判断才有用。她漂亮的维修成果体现了对手艺的热爱，丹尼尔逐渐感谢她的耐心。关系始终专业，但漫长的合作让双方深入理解彼此如何应对不确定性。

paragraphs.en: Not everyone supported the arrangement. A rude colleague dismissed rehabilitation as nonsense and treated Daniel with contempt. The mechanic was tempted to reply in rage or perform some crazy stunt to prove himself. Rosa warned him that this impulse was an illusion: a dramatic success could not erase a pattern of careless decisions. She also questioned the superficial labels people used. A shy worker was not necessarily incompetent, and a silent worker was not necessarily resentful. As a precaution, Daniel began recording every inspection step and asking another technician to confirm any uncertain result before the equipment returned to service.
paragraphs.zh: 并非人人支持这种安排。一名粗鲁同事认为改过自新是胡说，对丹尼尔很轻蔑。他想愤怒回击，或做疯狂壮举来证明自己。罗莎提醒，这是一种错觉：一次耀眼成功不能消除长期粗心。她也质疑肤浅标签，害羞不等于无能，沉默也不等于怨恨。为预防事故，丹尼尔开始记录每个检查步骤，并请另一位技师核实不确定结果，再让设备恢复使用。

paragraphs.en: After several months, Daniel completed a difficult repair without a single safety violation. The team gave a modest cheer, and he felt the thrill of earning trust through patient work. He was glad that his outlook had changed, although the earlier weeks had been miserable. The owner emphasized that judgments about people were often subjective: one incident could lead observers to see a colleague either as a fool or as a future expert. The useful question was whether the workplace helped people learn. A second chance was not permission to forget an error; it was an organized opportunity to prevent its repetition.
paragraphs.zh: 几个月后，丹尼尔完成一项艰难维修，没有违反任何安全规定。团队轻声欢呼，他感到靠耐心工作赢得信任的激动。虽然之前几周十分难熬，他很高兴看问题的方式变了。老板强调，对人的判断常常主观：一次事件可能让人把同事看成傻瓜，也可能看成未来专家。真正有用的问题是，工作环境能否帮助人学习。第二次机会不是准许忘记错误，而是有组织地防止重犯。
